playful.a: Homepage for "Bubbly Bites", a healthy-snack subscription box for kids: hero with mascot, what is in the box, a snack-quiz teaser, pricing, a parents section, CTA band.
playful.b: Page for a children's science museum weekend festival: activity zones, a Saturday and Sunday schedule, ticket tiers, safety information and a map teaser.

bold.a: Launch page for "Ridge", a trail-running shoe: dramatic hero, three technology highlights, athlete quotes, sizing guide, pre-order CTA.
bold.b: Landing page for an indie music festival called "Low Tide": lineup, dates and venue, ticket tiers, sponsor call-to-action.

technical.a: Database admin console for "Quillbase": query latency by shard, slow query list, replication lag chart, connection pool status and a SQL snippet panel.
technical.b: Cloud cost dashboard: spend by service, daily trend chart, anomaly alerts, top idle resources and tag coverage.

trust.a: Tax-prep portal for freelancers called "Taxwell": refund estimate, document checklist, upcoming deadlines, a flagged-deduction alert and a table of past filings.
trust.b: Pharmacy account dashboard: prescriptions ready for pickup, refills due, delivery tracking and an insurance status alert.

editorial.a: Long-read profile page about a ceramics studio, headline "Clay and Fire": standfirst, byline, body sections, a pull quote, related stories and a newsletter signup.
editorial.b: Travel essay page "Night Train to Trieste": headline, introduction, an itinerary sidebar, a pull quote and related essays.
